text: Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group's largest shareholders as of March 31, 2026 are trust and custody banks: Japan Master Trust (16.15%) and Japan Custody Bank (5.79%), ahead of State Street Bank and Trust (2.82%).
short: SMFG's largest shareholders are trust and custody banks.
